_README: Derived reference data for 234 Duffy Street, Ainslie. Everything here was computed from the source documents and validated; reuse it rather than re-deriving.

site.source_of_coords: Fortify Geotech borehole log, converted from MGA2020 zone 55 (EPSG:7855)

local_frame.description: All geometry uses a local metric frame taken from the Enfold site plan A1.01. Origin is the block corner shared by the 40.005 m south boundary and the 21.775 m rear boundary. +x runs along the 40 m boundary, +y along the frontage.
local_frame.meaning: +x = north-north-west toward Duffy Street. -x = south-south-east toward the reserve. +y = west-south-west. -y = east-north-east.
local_frame.survey_to_local_similarity: fit from the four boundary corners; survey pt (114.5,528.6),(663.8,669.0),(588.8,962.0),(99.2,836.9) map to the local corners above. Residuals under 5 mm.

ground_surface.description: Quadratic trend surface fitted to the surveyed 0.25 m contours. RL = c0 + c1*x + c2*y + c3*x^2 + c4*x*y + c5*y^2, metres AHD, x/y in the local frame.
ground_surface.validated_against: ten independent spot levels read off the survey; mean error -0.020 m, RMS 0.129 m
ground_surface.fall: 2.08 m from rear boundary to street, about 1 in 19. Cross-fall about 1 in 132.

fences.note: not recorded on the survey; measure and update. Each 300 mm costs the side strip about half an hour of summer sun.

trees.name: brittle gum, Eucalyptus mannifera x nicholii
trees.note: trunk is only 1.97 m from the rear boundary, so its structural root zone crosses the boundary by 830 mm. No channel can follow that boundary past it.

trees.name: Manchurian flowering pear, Pyrus ussuriensis
trees.note: RETAIN. The Class P classification and the 20-40 mm movement figure assume it stays. Hand excavation around it is approved.

trees.name: velvet ash street tree, Fraxinus velutina
velvet ash street tree, Fraxinus velutina
Japanese maple, in the courtyard
trees.status: not protected, well under all thresholds
trees.note: in poor health, assume it dies. Courtyard light roughly triples when it goes.

design_rainfall_mm_per_h.source: Bureau of Meteorology 2016 IFD, grid cell 35.2625S 149.1375E
design_rainfall_mm_per_h.standard: AS/NZS 3500.3: dwelling site drainage at 5 min duration, 1 in 10 year. Eaves gutters 1 in 20.

sun_hours.model: includes both neighbours and 1.8 m fences; deciduous canopies bare 1 Jun to 16 Sep (0.72 transmission) and dense otherwise (0.15); the gum modelled as a permanently open canopy at 0.55

corner_swale.note: the only stretch of rear boundary outside the gum's protection zone, so the only part that can be excavated

overland_path.note: MUST stay clear and continuous to the street. It is the route if the reserve bank fails.

free_to_regrade.pockets: a 4 m strip along the ENE boundary, a pocket at the WSW rear corner, and a 4 m band next to the house. Only 1.3 m2 of the middle is clear.
